name: Madoxx Davis
strengths: Davis returns the opening kick and weaves through the wedge, then turns on vertical speed and scores.
Davis stacks the corner on the deep sideline go and tracks the ball over his shoulder in stride.
Davis makes the first defender miss on manufactured screens and keeps his feet through arm tackles.
Davis spins off a wedge hit on the next return and accelerates up the sideline with the same compact burst.
weaknesses: Davis's sophomore reel is mostly gos and manufactured touches — intermediate route polish versus press is the next tape.
comparison: Davis comps to Jaylen Waddle — 5-10 / 182 compact slot-to-perimeter burner who wins with vertical speed, vision after the catch, and contact balance.
projection: Davis projects as a Year 1 return / package WR, then a Year 2 rotation piece, with Year 3 starter upside if the intermediate tree matches the deep ball.
schemeFit: Davis fits a speed WR / returner who can take the top off and win YAC on screens while the route tree grows.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-09-23 from Cartersville sophomore reel (embed 13575393 / 68dd4e5cc7273590630152b9), first 2:30 of the 9:41 sit. Comp size-matched within ~1 inch — not a Florida-alum default.
recruitingStory: Madoxx Davis is a 2028 WR · listed 5-10.5 / 190 · Cartersville (Cartersville, GA) · expected Ole Miss weekend in the Swamp.
angle: Lead with the kick-return score and the stacked go; Davis is a home-run WR / returner.
insiderNotes: Davis is a compact 5-10.5 / 190 receiver who scores on the opening kick return, stacks the corner on the go, and keeps his feet through arm tackles. The vertical speed is the trait. The intermediate tree still has to match those deep balls.
